title: test: wt-control-seats can't tell the control-seat route from the shared landing path (ps1 mutant survives)
definitionOfDone: wt-control-seats gives the architect and QA control seats at least one path the shared landing path would commit (an ASSERTED path via declare_files, or a TOOL-witnessed edit). It asserts that path is on no ref after the seat exits, and that exactly one MOE_COMMIT_NOTHING_TO_COMMIT row was recorded.

The completion summary carries mutation evidence: routing the control seat to the shared landing path makes wt-control-seats fail under both engines (moe-agent.ps1 via powershell, moe-agent.sh via bash).
node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs bash and node scripts/tests/postflight-safe.mjs powershell (Windows PowerShell 5.1) both report failureClass NONE, and parity-check PASSes.
Test-only: moe-agent.sh/.ps1 change only if the hardened case exposes a real defect, and the summary names that defect.
